query: 供应商环境标准 供应商环境标准 衡量供应链环境准入标准与约束机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的供应商环境准入标准（含碳足迹、排污等硬性指标）；实行动态环境分级管理，并根据分级结果执行差异化采购政策；有明确的违规处理机制（如红线淘汰制）。 • 1分（合格）：发布了供应商行为准则，包含基础的环境保护要求，具备初次准入的环境审核，但缺乏动态分级管理或明确的违规退出机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无供应商环境标准披露，或仅笼统提及“推行绿色采购”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署环境协议或执行环境标准的供应商数量（或采购额）占比 >80%。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对一级供应商/关键原材料供应商执行，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商环境标准 绿色采购 供应商行为准则 环境准入 供应商环境审核 分级管理 环境黑名单 供应商退出机制 supplier environmental standards green procurement supplier code of conduct environmental prequalification supplier environmental audit tiered supplier management environmental blacklist supplier exit mechanism 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商环境标准'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“绿色采购”；仅有企业自身环境政策；仅有供应商劳工准则而无环境条款；仅有一次性供应商培训活动；区分：本指标聚焦供应链环境准入与约束；供应商行为准则可能同时含劳工与环境，需抽出环境条款；企业环境政策不等于已对供应商设硬性标准；道德采购更偏人权/合规采购。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE / Supply Chain Management

[Content]
In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

results.text: An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE / Supply Chain Management

[Content]
An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.

A materiality assessment is carried out every alternate year to identify issues that are most material to the Group and its stakeholders. An independent consultancy firm is engaged for that. results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. The GHG emissions were mainly contributed by emissions from the use of electricity, which constituted around 62% of total GHG emissions.
